rules.sheet-feeder: One staged 0.50 x 0.40 x 0.0008m sheet Item is vacuum-picked, moved to the feed nip, released and roller-fed to output. No hidden sheet creation or implicit pile splitting.
rules.pile-lift: One declared 20-sheet pile Item,0.50 x0.40 x0.016m, moves from0.20m loading to0.90m delivery; same identity and sheet_count20. It is an aggregate pile stock unit, not20 independent runtime Items.

quantities: one input and same output Item; sheet_count1/20 and area0.20/4.0m2 retained
work: 12s feeder,15s lift; load20%,auto60%,unload20%; loading/unloading require actual operator capacity, automatic phase requires actual fixture calendar
integration: Explicit ItemType and Operation bindings required. Aggregate pile and individual sheet are different types; this batch does not automatically convert or split one into the other.
geometry: Original illustrative mechanical geometry and CC0 micro-surfaces; editable package-local source; no manufacturer CAD or rated performance claim.
